sloka: पद्भ्यां तु शैलमापीड्य वडवामुखवन्मुखम्।विवृत्योग्रं ननादोच्चैस्त्रासयन्निव राक्षसान् ।। ६.७४.४६ ।।
transliteration: padbhyāṁ tu śailamāpīḍya vaḍavāmukhavanmukham।vivṛtyograṁ nanādoccaistrāsayanniva rākṣasān ।। 6.74.46 ।।

translations.english: Pressing the mountain hard by his feet, opening his largemouth wide, he roared like Rakshasas to make Rakshasas fearful.
